cases.purpose: unsignalled Conflict(3)+Complete on the parked RW T: commit Aborted0, RW(T) u1-u3 plus the T's Open descriptor cursor u8-u10 Released; Plan/Binding of both slots untouched
unsignalled Conflict(3)+Incomplete: commit NCR1 (RW+Incomplete), first-fence census with the parked T as cause: new O n1 NCR, RW3 before=after Held, new Recovery u11; cursor u8-u10 not released

unsignalled Rows(0)+Incomplete on the RW T: class keeps cleanup2/commit NCR1 (RW+Incomplete) but, per proposal section 7 'Resume 무신호 Rows/Buffer -> owners empty, supplied cleanup raw kept', the owner/O set is empty (no census); combination is excluded by the model after admission
unsignalled Eof(1)+Complete on the explicit RW T: only C(result) u8-u10 Released, RW3 kept (not listed), commit 255

cancel-signalled pending + Conflict(3)+Complete: pending terminal cleanup regardless of work -> only C(result) u8-u10 Released, RW3 kept, commit 255 (no unsignalled-Conflict Aborted0); control copies the cancel bit

deadline-reached pending + Conflict(3)+Incomplete: pending Incomplete is the fence path, identical census to the unsignalled case (cause O n1 NCR, RW3 before=after, Recovery u11, cursor not released), commit NCR1; control copies the reached bit

notes: R1 Matching ParkedFetch (readset-v2 section 5): actor0.parked_context = c6, the context is ParkedFetch with statement/result/transaction Some, the private descriptor of R[4,0,1,1,1,1,1] links p2/slot1/T n1, and T.parked_context backlinks c6. Context = original c6; control = (original_deadline, cancel bit, reached bit) copied exactly. No fresh Context is used (next Context 7 is not read). Fact = caller attached E1, next Fact 3. Transaction = Parked.transaction T n1.

R2 Resume Env bytes (wire-v2 Env1 layout line 84 and class table; proposal section 6 Resume row): work_kind Resume, work_class = outcome div 2 (Rows0/Eof1/ReadError2/Conflict3/RowBufferTooSmall4), cleanup = 1 + outcome mod 2, commit = NCR1 for RW+Incomplete, Aborted0 for RW+Complete+unsignalled Conflict, else 255; receipt/anchor None.

R3 Unsignalled Conflict Complete (proposal section 7 'Execute/Fetch/Resume 무신호 Conflict Complete | 선택 RW + 해당 transaction의 현재 Open cursor release'; contract: 'Fetch·Resume Conflict와 Rollback Complete는 RW(T)와 T의 Open descriptor cursor 전체를 release'): RW3 u1-u3 and the cursor u8-u10 of T's only Open descriptor are Released. Plan/Binding u4-u7 are untouched.

R4 A second Open cursor of the same T in slot0 was NOT included. The state keeps a single actor.active_public_result, and Execute/CommitAtomic treat another active result as ResultBusy, so two simultaneous Open descriptors are not coherent. Terminal (Eof/Error/Closed) descriptors of T already have all cursor owners Released (C(R) release on EOF/ReadError/Close), so an 'Open only' vs 'all live cursors of T' difference cannot be made observable in a coherent state. A non-reachable read-set workspace with two Open descriptors could test it if D2 accepts one.

R5 Incomplete with or without a pending signal is the first-fence path (proposal section 7 'Incomplete ... 첫 fence | census'; wire-v2 Resume row 'Incomplete는 fence'). The engine is Admitting and T n1 is the only live RW T, so: cause new O [10,0,255,1,1,1,0] with raw NCR, RW3 before=after Held, new Recovery at next Resource [9,0,255,1,1,11,0], count 4/AllHeld. The cursor is not released ('cause cursor도 incomplete 사실로 release하지 않는다'). This matches the existing RO-T fixtures, where pending+Incomplete has no cursor rows.

R6 DISAGREEMENT with the request, case rw-resume-rows-incomplete: the request expected 'commit NCR1, same census' for unsignalled Rows+Incomplete. I authored owners/O EMPTY with cleanup 2 and commit NCR1. Basis: assembler-proposal-v1 section 7 explicit row 'Fetch Rows/Buffer 또는 Resume 무신호 Rows/Buffer | owners empty. Resume의 supplied cleanup raw값은 그대로 유지'. That clause about keeping the raw cleanup only has content for the Incomplete case. Also wire-v2 Resume row: '무신호는 Fetch 대응' (Fetch Rows has an empty owner set) and 'Rows/RowBufferTooSmall/Eof+Incomplete는 admitted 뒤 제외'. Commit stays NCR1 because the Env class table ('RW+Incomplete는1') is independent of the owner recipe. If the owner instead decides that every Incomplete Resume runs the census, the expected owners/obligations become exactly those of rw-resume-conflict-incomplete with work_class 0.

R7 Pending Complete (proposal section 7 'Resume pending Complete | C(R) release, explicit/OFF RW 보존'; wire-v2 'pending Cancel/Deadline이면 work와 무관하게 C(result) cleanup, Complete는 explicit/OFF RW 보존'): with the cancel bit set, Conflict Complete releases only the cursor, keeps RW3, and has commit 255, since the Aborted0 rule is only for unsignalled Conflict.
R8 Unsignalled Eof Complete follows Fetch Eof Complete (wire-v2 '무신호는 Fetch 대응'; Fetch Eof Complete 'C(result) Released, explicit/OFF RW 보존'): cursor rows only, commit 255.

R9 Signal variants change only the parked context bits (SignalContext has no context/fact of its own, as original sel.signalled and rich:parked-fetch-cancel). All bases are in this file or original:, and each case carries a 'purpose' string.
